name: Contact | Wild Lake Studio
description: Contact Wild-Lake directly or compile an optional email draft with work, structural bottleneck, engagement format, and target horizon.
headline: Let’s begin.

hasPart.name: Let’s begin.
hasPart.text: Let’s begin. NEW YORK / TAMPA / SANTIAGO / WORLDWIDE Wild-Lake has bases in New York, Tampa, and Santiago. We also collaborate remotely, without requiring in-person intensive sessions. Artists can inquire directly or through managers, booking agents, labels, galleries, and institutions. Identify the work, the structural bottleneck, and the conditions or timeline you are building toward. Review Offerings, The method, and Engagements & pricing beforehand to establish shared operating terms before submitting work. Argelys Samuel Oriach, Founder and artistic director, uses Universe API to scope the constraint, the intervention to test, and the evidence to review. info@wildlakestudio.com

hasPart.name: Diagnostic intake
hasPart.text: Diagnostic intake These prompts and fields are optional. Include the facts that help us identify the constraint, the engagement format, and the target horizon. You can also write directly by email. If you are an artist What is the core body of work, and what stage is it in? Where is your current practice or infrastructure breaking down? What conditions or timeline are you building toward over the next 12 months? If you represent a label, gallery, agency or institution Which artist, roster, or program requires support? What is the operational bottleneck, release/exhibition timeline, or institutional demand? Which engagement structure fits best (retainer, intensive, or fixed commission)? Your message (optional) Engagement format (optional) Not sure yet Established artist (Retainer and intensive) Rising artist (Subsidized Stewardship subscription) Fixed project fee Institutional partnership Include if you can A link to the work. Your name. A link to the work (optional) Your name (optional)
